# dsh-plugin-mail-triage
Mail triage and safe cleanup for **DeepSeek Harness**.

Read-only incremental triage first, an explicit approval second, and only then a
move to Trash. Read

ing and writing are separate tools with separate code paths,
and there is no expunge anywhere in thi

riting are separate tools with separate code paths,
and there is no expunge anywhere in this plugin.
简体中文说明见 README.zh.md.

## Tools
| Tool | Access | Purpose |
| `mail_triage_accounts` | metadata | `list`, `import_thunderbird`, `set_secret`, `test`, `remove` |

| `mail_triage_scan` | read-only | incremental scan, rules, local model, report |
| `mail_triage_re

view` | local | read the yellow queue / record verdicts |
| `mail_triage_plan` | read-only | build t

he delete list and manifest |
| `mail_triage_apply` | **write** | after approval, move to Trash |
|
`mail_triage_audit` | read-only | audit log, reports, manifests |
## Credentials come from Thunderbird

No manual typing: the plugin decrypts the local Thunderbird profile
(`key4.db` + `logins.json`) and

stores the account secrets in the DSH credential
store. Decryption happens locally with `node:sqlite

` and `node:crypto` — no
Python, no NSS DLL, no native modules. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing is

written to the workspace in plaintext: if the host exposes no credential
service, saving a secret fa

ils with an explanation instead of falling back to a
file.

## Safety properties enforced in code

- The rule layer can only protect; it never creates a deletion on its own.
- Low confidence, an inva

lid model schema, a timeout or a missing model all fall
to the yellow bucket.
- OTP, invoice, phishi

ng, attachment, official, academic, personal and
sent/draft categories are never auto-deleted.
- Del

etion is MOVE to `\Trash`; if no Trash mailbox resolves, the plugin refuses
instead of guessing.
- T

he manifest carries a content hash that is re-verified before execution.
- Every move is audited.
-

Passwords and OAuth tokens live in the Host credential store only. With no
credential service availa

ble the plugin refuses to store or read one rather
than writing a plaintext file next to the reports

le the plugin refuses to store or read one rather
than writing a plaintext file next to the reports.
## State

Workspace `.mail-triage/`: `config.json`, `state.json` (cursors), `labels.jsonl`,
`verdicts.jsonl`,

`audit.jsonl`, `manifests/`, `reports/`. Plain text, yours to
inspect or delete.

## Known limitations

- If a Gmail account's Thunderbird Google grant cannot be refreshed, store a
16-character app passwo

ication still works, the summary text is just ugly.
- When a header block exceeds 8 KB (long DKIM/AR

C chains) the body is fetched a
second time; if it is still unavailable the snippet stays empty.
- I

f a Thunderbird OAuth grant has expired, the plugin reports it honestly:
sign in again in Thunderbir

d, then re-run `import_thunderbird`.
- Only INBOX is scanned by default (configurable); sub-folders

are not expanded.
- `node:sqlite` needs Node 22.5 or newer. The runtime bundled with DSH satisfies
t

his; on an older host the plugin fails to load instead of degrading.
- A secret typed into `set_secr

et`, and a Thunderbird primary password typed into
`import_thunderbird`, become part of the conversa

tion transcript. Prefer
`import_thunderbird` when Thunderbird already holds the password.
- A plaint

ext `.mail-triage/secrets.json` left by a build before 1.0.2 is moved
into the credential store and

deleted the next time `mail_triage_accounts`
runs. If the service is unreachable the file is left al

one and the tool says
to delete it by hand.
## Development note

After editing plugin code the Host still holds the previous module instance:
toggle the plugin off a

nd on in the Plugins panel to load the new code (no full
restart needed).
